research.title: Calibration Evaluation for Regularized Classifiers
bullets: Implemented assigned logistic regression evaluation routines using predefined train and validation splits to examine probability calibration on imbalanced tabular datasets.
Generated reliability diagrams and computed Brier scores under specified regularization settings, documenting discrepancies between predicted probabilities and observed class frequencies.

work.title: Validation and Maintenance of Tabular Data Imports
bullets: Implemented Python validation checks for incoming tabular records, handling missing fields, inconsistent data types, and duplicate identifiers within existing import workflows.
Added regression tests for malformed input cases and corrected parsing defects, preserving established interfaces and documenting error handling behavior.

projects.title: Ridge Regression Baseline for Tabular Prediction
bullets: Implemented a ridge regression baseline with scikit-learn, applying training-set standardization and cross-validation to select the regularization parameter for continuous outcome prediction.
Compared held-out prediction errors against an ordinary least squares baseline and inspected residual plots for systematic deviations across target ranges.
